_note: Store/native version source of truth for the soft 'Update available' prompt. For each STORE release, bump BOTH `latest_version` AND `latest_version_code` to the values of the binary you ACTUALLY UPLOADED — read them from android/app/build.gradle (versionName / versionCode) and ios/*/Info.plist, NOT from app.config.js, which drifts whenever the native project is edited without a prebuild. A stale latest_version_code is what silently killed the 1.0.4 prompt: it was left at 8 (the 1.0.1 release) while the store build was 11. `show_again_after_days` re-shows a dismissed update after N days. This is the NATIVE store version, NOT the OTA bundle version in production.json. The iOS store_url is deliberately storefront-less (no /in/, /us/, … segment) so App Store links open in the user's own country storefront; the numeric id6793104519 is what identifies the app. Editing ANY field here invalidates `signature` — the OTA workflow re-signs (scripts/ota/sign-manifest.mjs) before copying this file to the public artifacts repo, so never hand-copy it there.
